name: git_response_schema
description: D33 dual-host catalog: stable GitResponse keys and stderr prefixes for orch error paths. Hosts must emit these prefixes (substring-stable); do not paraphrase in product code or matchers. stderr_prefixes MUST match contracts/git.kdl stderr-prefix (gen/git.gen.ts STDERR_PREFIX) — ids and prefix strings are the dual-host catalog of record.

stderr_prefixes.notes: connection-bound remote with unknown catalog ref; must match git.kdl
list-refs ok but upload-pack body empty; must match git.kdl
bare URL or connection origin policy deny; must match git.kdl
pull FF-only cannot advance HEAD to remote tip; must match git.kdl

stderr_prefixes.prefix: git: guest body must not include auth secrets
stderr_prefixes.notes: guest body token/auth/password keys rejected; must match git.kdl
read-only mount rejects push before dial; must match git.kdl
smart-HTTP 3xx rejected (no Location follow); must match git.kdl
connection definition has empty origins list; must match git.kdl

stderr_prefixes.prefix: git: query auth not supported for remotes
stderr_prefixes.notes: connection auth kind query rejected for remotes; must match git.kdl
